about.title: Hotel Valeritos, your base in Ecuador.
paragraphs: Hotel Valeritos is a family-run hostel in Ecuador, run by its owners. We offer private and shared rooms, free WiFi, a fully equipped kitchen, pool and BBQ. We're in the city center, close to everything you need.

location.description: Ecuador. Close to the best attractions.

pricing.title: Message us for updated prices based on your dates.

faq.question: Can I bring my pet?
faq.answer: Ask us, sometimes we can make it work. We don't say no right away.

faq.question: Is breakfast included?
faq.answer: It depends on the season, message us and we'll confirm.

faq.question: Are towels provided?
faq.answer: Message us, we usually have towels available to lend.

faq.question: Is there a pool?
faq.answer: Yes! In summer it's the best spot to cool off after sightseeing.

faq.question: How do I get around the city?
faq.answer: Reach out and we'll tell you the best transport options and what to visit nearby.
